metadata.case_name: CHAN SHING CHING v. HONG KONG DISTRICT SECURITY LIMITED AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: Due to the fall from the staircase to the ground the Plaintiff had a laceration wound at his right leg with bones exposed. X ray examination shows fracture at his right tibia and fibular.
source: Due to the fall from the staircase to the ground the Plaintiff had a laceration wound at his right leg with bones exposed. X ray examination shows fracture at his right tibia and fibular.

manifestations.description: pain of the right lower limb
weakness of the right lower limb
very significant weakness and calf wasting
right thigh muscle wasting (2 cm in 2003; measurements recorded in reports)
requires walking frame or walking sticks when walking; relies on a stick or walking frame
unable to do hiking which he used to enjoy prior to the accident

treatments_received: On 7.2002, wound debridement and application of external skeletal fixator was done.
On 16.7.2002, removal of external fixator and intramedullary nailing of the right tibia was done.
From 1.8.200 to 5.8.2002 he was admitted to the Tseung Kwan O Hospital for treatment of skin graft wound infection.
He was confined to a wheelchair for 4 months after the accident.
Discharged home with a walking frame on 27.7.2002.
treatments_future: operation to remove the metal implants (implant removal operation) as advised by Dr. Fu

losses.description: When walking he still relies on a stick or a walking frame.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: He cannot do hiking which he used to enjoy prior to the accident.
There can hardly be any prospect of his being re-employed as a security guard; he could not resume his former job as a security guard.
Scarring as noted by Dr. Fu and referred to in assessment of permanent impairment.
